baseline_sources.source_context: OpenAI identified elevated errors for FedRAMP workspaces and API organisations at 9:23 p.m. on 15 June 2026 and said it was working on mitigation. It continued investigating at 10:16 p.m. on 15 June, 1:24 a.m. on 17 June and 7:41 p.m. on 18 June; it marked all impacted services fully recovered at 11:07 p.m. on 26 June. The public notice names the FedRAMP component but does not identify root cause, customer count or specific affected functions.
